description: This file is a Markdown document detailing the Playwright BrowserType class, including usage examples in multiple programming languages, method descriptions, parameters, and options related to launching and connecting to browsers using Playwright.

classes.name: BrowserType
classes.description: Represents a browser type used to launch or connect to browser instances, such as Chromium, Firefox, or WebKit. Provides methods for launching browsers, connecting over protocols, and retrieving executable paths.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Attaches Playwright to an existing browser instance created via a WebSocket endpoint. Allows controlling a running browser without launching a new one.

methods.name: connectOverCDP
methods.description: Attaches Playwright to an existing Chromium-based browser using the Chrome DevTools Protocol, enabling control over the specified browser.

methods.name: executablePath
methods.description: Returns the path where the Playwright bundled browser executable is located.

methods.name: launch
methods.description: Launches a new browser instance, such as Chromium, with optional parameters like ignoring default arguments or setting slow motion.

methods.name: launchPersistentContext
methods.description: Creates a persistent browser context with user data stored at a specified directory, useful for retaining session data across runs.

methods.name: launchServer
methods.description: Launches a browser server that can be connected to later via WebSocket. Useful for scenarios where multiple clients need to connect to a single browser process.

methods.name: name
methods.description: Returns the name of the browser type, such as 'chromium', 'firefox', or 'webkit'.
